blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks rebounded Friday as investors bought beaten-down shares. Meanwhile, a pause in the peso’s slide offered some relief to market sentiment. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) climbed 1.61 percent, or 90.60 points, to close at 5,700.99, partially reversing Thursday’s 2.2-percent decline. READ: Peso sinks to fresh record low of 62.90:$1 The broader All Shares index rose 1.47 percent, or 46.30 points, to 3,191.85. Luis Limlingan, head of sales at Regina Capital Development Corp., attributed the recovery to broad market buying and bargain hunting after recent losses.
